title: Equivariant Modeling with Polynomial Features via Minimal Homogeneous Generators
abstract: arXiv:2611.24896v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a general framework for modeling and learning equivariant functions between finite dimensional semisimple real group representations, unifying constructions developed across many application areas. Our model is a linear combination of equivariant polynomial features whose coefficients are arbitrary learnable functions of invariant polynomial features. We take as features minimal homogeneous generators for the invariant algebra and the covariant module over the invariant algebra, up to prescribed degrees. We provide a Python package that automatically computes these features and fits the resulting models to training data. The algorithm for feature computation requires explicit isotypic decompositions of the input and output representations, along with explicit Clebsch-Gordan decompositions of the tensor product of irreducible representations, and achieves speedups over alternative methods in computational algebra. translated_title: 基于最小齐次生成元的多项式特征等变建模
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个用于建模和学习有限维半单实群表示之间等变函数的通用框架，该框架统一了众多应用领域中发展出的各种构造方法。我们的模型是等变多项式特征的线性组合，其系数是不变多项式特征的任意可学习函数。我们选取不变代数以及不变代数上协变模的最小齐次生成元作为特征，直至给定的阶数。我们提供了一个Python包，可自动计算这些特征并将所得模型拟合到训练数据。特征计算算法需要输入和输出表示的显式同型分解，以及不可约表示张量积的显式Clebsch-Gordan分解，并在计算代数方面相比其他方法实现了加速。数值实验（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于最小齐次生成元构造等变多项式特征的通用等变函数建模框架，并提供了可自动计算特征与拟合模型的Python工具包，同时给出了更高效的特征计算算法。
